caption:
Six games. Six wins. One more tonight.

India's women play China in the Women's Asian Champions Trophy final in Bhopal at 7 pm IST. A win would be a third straight title.

The last time these two met, on November 24, India were 3-0 up inside 14 minutes. Deepika scored all three: one reverse hit from open play and two penalty corners. It finished 6-2, India's biggest win over China at this event.

That is the pattern of the whole run. Dainik Jagran reports Deepika leads the scoring with 10 goals and nine of them came from penalty corners.

But China only needed one goal to reach this final. They beat Japan 1-0 with a 60th-minute winner from Zhang Heyang. This is also the side that won Olympic silver in Paris. Former Olympian Sameer Dad rates India's chances at 60:40.
